pairs.target: dìèrtiān , tǎ wéi xiàlóu shí , yuànlǐ de bǔ lán chē yǐjīng tào hǎo le luózǐ .
pairs.english: The next morning, when Tavi came downstairs, the mule was already harnessed to the railing-repair cart in the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天，塔维下楼时，院里的补栏车已经套好了骡子。

pairs.target: dù yīng zhàn zài chē páng diǎn liào , tīngjiàn zhǎngguì hǎn tā chī zǎofàn , biàn bǎ bànkuài bǐng yǎo zài zuǐlǐ , shǒushàng hái bùkěn tíng .
pairs.english: Du Ying checked the supplies beside the cart; hearing the innkeeper call her to breakfast, she put half a flatbread in her mouth and still refused to stop her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 杜缨站在车旁点料，听见掌柜喊她吃早饭，便把半块饼咬在嘴里，手上还不肯停。

pairs.target: tā jīnrì kàn de shì wǎng shānmén qù de nàduàn , hé nài lěi tāmen bùtóng lù , zhī cháonánbiān tái le tái xiàbā , shuō zuówǎn yùn mùliào de huò chéng yě wǎng nà tóu zǒu .
pairs.english: Today she was inspecting the stretch toward the mountain gate, a different way from Nerai’s; she merely nodded south and said Huo Cheng, last night’s timber hauler, was heading that way too.
pairs.hanzi: 她今日看的是往山门去的那段，和奈蕾他们不同路，只朝南边抬了抬下巴，说昨晚运木料的霍成也往那头走。

pairs.target: nà nánrén zhèng dūn zhe jìxiédài , tīngjiàn zìjǐ de míngzì , táitóu shuō bié bǎ tā suàn chéng yǐnlù de , tā yě shì qù wèn xià tóu nà pī mùtou shénme shíhòu néng sòngshànglái .
pairs.english: The man was crouching to tie his shoes; hearing his name, he looked up and said not to count him as a guide—he too was only going to ask when the timber below could be brought up.
pairs.hanzi: 那男人正蹲着系鞋带，听见自己的名字，抬头说别把他算成引路的，他也是去问下头那批木头什么时候能送上来。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō tóng zǒu yíduàn biàn hǎo , bú jiè tā de shúlù chāojìn dào .
pairs.english: Nerai said they could simply walk together for a while, without borrowing his local knowledge to take shortcuts.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说同走一段便好，不借他的熟路抄近道。

pairs.target: zǎofàn hòu , tā bǎ yìzhī biǎn mùxiá fàngdào tǎ wéi miànqián , jiào tā xiān jiāng pángbiān nàgēn shéngzi shōuchéng xiǎoquān .
pairs.english: After breakfast, she set a flat wooden case before Tavi and told him first to coil that rope beside it into small loops.
pairs.hanzi: 早饭后，她把一只扁木匣放到塔维面前，叫他先将旁边那根绳子收成小圈。

pairs.target: xiá lǐ búshì xuégōng nà duì tiěliào , shì tā zìjǐ de liǎngpiàn jiā huáng , bèimiàn gè yǒu yìháng jiù jìhào , jiēchù chù lù zhe mó jìng de jīnshǔ .
pairs.english: Inside were not the academy’s pair of iron pieces but her own two spring strips, each bearing a line of old marks on its back and polished bare metal at the contact patch.
pairs.hanzi: 匣里不是学宫那对铁料，是她自己的两片夹簧，背面各有一行旧记号，接触处露着磨净的金属。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn dōu búguò shǒuzhǎng cháng , yípiàn lián zhe zhǎi kòu , lìng yípiàn gē zài yǒu dǎng biān de mùcáo lǐ , bùnéng wǎng wài luàntán .
pairs.english: Both were only palm-length; one joined a narrow clasp, while the other rested in a wooden channel with raised sides that kept it from springing out.
pairs.hanzi: 两片都不过手掌长，一片连着窄扣，另一片搁在有挡边的木槽里，不能往外乱弹。

pairs.target: tā xiān hé guò jiù jìhào hé quán jiàn , yòu yòng xiǎo zhòngwù shì le liǎngbiān , zài jiāng nà zhī dài shéng de dà tiěgōu fàngdào zhǎi kòuxià .
pairs.english: She first checked the old marks and each whole piece, also tested both with a small weight, then put the large rope-hook beneath the narrow clasp.
pairs.hanzi: 她先核过旧记号和全件，又用小重物试了两边，再将那只带绳的大铁钩放到窄扣下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde tándòng de chābié , yě rènde chù miàn zhōuwéi nà dào qiǎn cáo , shǒu què liúzài zìjǐ de shéngquān shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the difference in flex and recognized the shallow groove around the contact patch, but kept his hands on his own coil.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得弹动的差别，也认得触面周围那道浅槽，手却留在自己的绳圈上。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuāngshǒu tiēzhù liǎngpiàn , zhǎi kòu nà piàn jiànjiàn ràng de kāi xiē , mùcáo lǐ de lìng yípiàn biàn méi nàme kěn wān .
pairs.english: Nerai touched both strips with her hands; the clasp strip gradually yielded more, while the one in the wooden channel became less willing to bend.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾双手贴住两片，窄扣那片渐渐让得开些，木槽里的另一片便没那么肯弯。

pairs.target: tā tóngshí chè kāi liǎngshǒu , yòng mǔzhǐ bǎ xiāozǐ sòng jìn gōu huán de kòuyǎn , jīnshǔ xìxì xiǎng le yíxià , suíjí yòu jiāng liǎngchù tóngshí tiē huí , shōudiào jiāohuàn , liǎngpiàn dōu huí le yuányàng .
pairs.english: She lifted both hands together, thumbed the pin through the hook’s eye with a faint metallic click, then touched both patches again and withdrew the exchange; the two strips both returned to normal.
pairs.hanzi: 她同时撤开两手，用拇指把销子送进钩环的扣眼，金属细细响了一下，随即又将两处同时贴回，收掉交换，两片都回了原样。

pairs.target: zhè yíchuàn dòngzuò duǎn de tǎ wéi gāng zhāngzuǐ , tā yǐjīng ná qǐ dà gōu , chá guò xiāozǐ , cái bǎ xiǎo zhòngwù xièxià .
pairs.english: The sequence was so brief that Tavi had only opened his mouth when she picked up the hook, checked the pin, and only then removed the small weight.
pairs.hanzi: 这一串动作短得塔维刚张嘴，她已经拿起大钩，查过销子，才把小重物卸下。

pairs.target: " shéng shàng zhēn guà rén , kào de shì gōu hé xiāo , búshì děng wǒ yìzhí ànzhe . "
pairs.english: “If there's a person on the rope, it's the hook and pin that hold them, not me keeping my hands pressed there.”
pairs.hanzi: “绳上真挂人，靠的是钩和销，不是等我一直按着。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng xiǎo jiājù zhuāng huí xiá lǐ , dà gōu hé shéng lìngwài kòu zài pídài wài , jiào tā kànkàn zìjǐ de bāo dài háiyǒu méiyǒu sōng chù .
pairs.english: She packed the small fixture into the case, fastened the big hook and rope separately outside her leather bag, and told him to check whether his own pack straps were loose.
pairs.hanzi: 她将小夹具装回匣里，大钩和绳另外扣在皮袋外，叫他看看自己的包带还有没有松处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu qiú zhe shì , dītóu lēijǐn bāo dài , hūrán hěn xiǎng zhīdào tā yǐqián jiūjìng zài nǎér yòng guò tā .
pairs.english: Tavi did not ask to try; looking down to tighten his straps, he suddenly wanted to know exactly where she had used it before.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有求着试，低头勒紧包带，忽然很想知道她以前究竟在哪儿用过它。

pairs.target: chūménshí , nài lěi bǎ xiě le dǐ zhàn shíchén de duǎn tiáo jiāogěi huǒjì , wènqīng jīnrì wǔqián suí huíchéng yì jiǎo zǒu , cái tóngtǎ wéi líkāi .
pairs.english: At departure, Nerai handed the worker a note with their arrival time and confirmed it would leave before noon with today's city-bound courier before setting off with Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，奈蕾把写了抵站时辰的短条交给伙计，问清今日午前随回城驿脚走，才同塔维离开。

pairs.target: huò chéng zài lùkǒu gǎnshànglái , jiānshàng méiyǒu mùliào , zhǐ bēizhe fàn bāo hé yìbǎ bāozhù rèn de duǎn fǔ .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng caught up at the junction with no timber on his shoulder, only a meal bundle on his back and a small axe with its blade wrapped.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成在路口赶上来，肩上没有木料，只背着饭包和一把包住刃的短斧。

pairs.target: tā wèn zuówǎn nà diǎn lǜ huà xiàlái méiyǒu , tǎ wéi shuō huà hēi le , huò chéng xiào de fàn bāo zài bèishàng huàng , jiào tā xiàhuí dài kuài lǜ bù , wǎng zhǐ shàng yì tiē jiùsuàn .
pairs.english: He asked if Tavi had drawn last night’s green; Tavi said it came out black, and Huo Cheng laughed so hard the meal bundle on his back bobbed, telling him next time to bring a piece of green cloth and stick it on the paper—that would do.
pairs.hanzi: 他问昨晚那点绿画下来没有，塔维说画黑了，霍成笑得饭包在背上晃，叫他下回带块绿布，往纸上一贴就算。

pairs.target: tāmen zǒuguò liǎngchù hái néng wàngjiàn yìzhàn de zhuǎnwān , lù zhújiàn tiējìn shānbì , wàicè yǒu yìtiáo gòng rén ràng chē de mù biàn dào .
pairs.english: They passed two bends from which the station was still visible; the road gradually hugged the cliff, with a wooden footway on the outer side for people giving way to carts.
pairs.hanzi: 他们走过两处还能望见驿站的转弯，路逐渐贴近山壁，外侧有一条供人让车的木便道。

pairs.target: biàn dào bù kuān , mùbǎn xià diàn zhe héngliáng , zài wǎng wài biànshì suìshí hé dǒupō , zuóyè de shuǐ cóng bǎn fènglǐ yìdiǎn diǎndī xiàqù .
pairs.english: The footway was narrow, its boards resting on crossbeams; beyond lay loose stones and a steep slope, and last night’s water dripped slowly through the gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 便道不宽，木板下垫着横梁，再往外便是碎石和陡坡，昨夜的水从板缝里一点点滴下去。

pairs.target: qiántou yíliàng tiāodàn de xiǎochē tíng zhe , liǎnggè nánrén zài yìtiáo héng lù de shéng páng zhēngzhí , qízhōng yígè chuānzhe dǎbǔdīng de huī duǎnguà , shǒulǐ ná zhe mùpái .
pairs.english: A little basket-carrying cart stood ahead, with two men arguing beside a rope across the road; one of them wore a patched grey jacket and held a wooden token in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 前头一辆挑担的小车停着，两个男人在一条横路的绳旁争执，其中一个穿着打补丁的灰短褂，手里拿着木牌。

pairs.target: tā jiàn nài lěi guòlái , xiān cháo tā jǐng biān kàn le yìyǎn , shuō qiántou huài le , yào shōu ràoxíng de qián , yì rén bā wén .
pairs.english: Seeing Nerai approach, he glanced once at her neck first and said the road ahead was damaged: he would collect a fee for the detour, eight coppers each.
pairs.hanzi: 他见奈蕾过来，先朝她颈边看了一眼，说前头坏了，要收绕行的钱，一人八文。

pairs.target: nài lěi tíng zài shānbì zhèbiān , méiyǒu wǎng shéng páng kào , zhī wèn rào dào nǎlǐ , shuí ràng tā zài yìlù shang shōuqián .
pairs.english: Nerai stopped on the cliff side without approaching the rope, asking only where the detour went and who had told him to collect money on the post road.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾停在山壁这边，没有往绳旁靠，只问绕到哪里，谁让他在驿路上收钱。

pairs.target: nánrén bǎ mùpái fānguòlái gěi tā kàn , què méiyǒu ná jìn , shàngmiàn zhǐyǒu jǐdào mòxiàn , jiǎoluò zhān zhe xīn ní .
pairs.english: The man turned the wooden token toward her without bringing it closer; it bore only a few ink lines, with fresh mud stuck in one corner.
pairs.hanzi: 男人把木牌翻过来给她看，却没有拿近，上面只有几道墨线，角落沾着新泥。

pairs.target: huò chéng wǎngqián bànbù , shuō zuówǎn dù yīng hái zài yìzhàn , yào xiū nǎ yíduàn , zěnme méi tīng tā shuō guò zhèbǐ qián .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng stepped forward half a pace and said Du Ying had still been at the station last night; what section needed repair, and why had she not mentioned this fee?
pairs.hanzi: 霍成往前半步，说昨晚杜缨还在驿站，要修哪一段，怎么没听她说过这笔钱。

pairs.target: huī guà nánrén xiào le , shuō xuégōng de rén guǎn xuégōng de , zhèbiān bù guī tā , jiào tā bié ná biérén míngzì dǐ zìjǐ de guòlù qián .
pairs.english: The man in the grey jacket laughed and said academy people minded academy business; this side was not under her authority, and he told him not to use someone else’s name to pay his own toll.
pairs.hanzi: 灰褂男人笑了，说学宫的人管学宫的，这边不归她，叫他别拿别人名字抵自己的过路钱。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi jiē tā de xiào , wǎng tǎ wéi shēn qián nuó le yìdiǎn , shuō xiān huí yìzhàn wèn , bù zǒu zhè tiáo ràolù .
pairs.english: Nerai did not return his smile; moving a little forward, in front of Tavi, she said they would ask at the station first and not take this detour.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没接他的笑，往塔维身前挪了一点，说先回驿站问，不走这条绕路。

pairs.target: tā gāng dài zhe tā zhuǎnshēn , hòumiàn yìjiān fèi wū de mén biàn kāi le , yígè kuānjiān nánrén zǒu chūlái , zhàn zài tāmen tuìhuíqù de lùshang .
pairs.english: Just as she turned with him, the door of an abandoned hut opened behind them; a broad-shouldered man emerged and blocked their way back.
pairs.hanzi: 她刚带着他转身，后面一间废屋的门便开了，一个宽肩男人走出来，站在他们退回去的路上。

pairs.target: tā shǒulǐ méiyǒu mùpái , zhǐyǒu yìgēn duǎn gùn , gùn tóu tiēzhe tuǐ , yíxiàyixià pèng kùfèng .
pairs.english: He held no wooden token, only a short cudgel; its head rested against his leg and tapped his trouser seam again and again.
pairs.hanzi: 他手里没有木牌，只有一根短棍，棍头贴着腿，一下一下碰裤缝。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de shǒumō dào nèi dài , nài lěi ànzhù tā shǒuwàn , jiào tā bié tāo , yě biépǎo dào wàicè qù .
pairs.english: Tavi’s hand reached for his inner pocket; Nerai caught his wrist and told him not to reach in or run onto the outer side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的手摸到内袋，奈蕾按住他手腕，叫他别掏，也别跑到外侧去。

pairs.target: qiántou nà rén bǎ mùpái rēng dào jiǎo biān , lùchū yāojiān yì jié duǎndāo bǐng , shuō jìrán bùkěn yì rén bā wén , jiù bǎ dàizǐ dōu fàngxià .
pairs.english: The man ahead tossed the token at his feet, revealing a short knife hilt at his waist; if they would not pay eight coppers each, he said, they should put down all their bags.
pairs.hanzi: 前头那人把木牌扔到脚边，露出腰间一截短刀柄，说既然不肯一人八文，就把袋子都放下。

pairs.target: huò chéng mà le yìshēng , tǎ wéi hái méi tīng qīng , shānbì shàng biàn zhàkāi yìxiǎopiàn bái xiè , suìshí cā guò tā de ěrduo .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng swore; Tavi had not yet made out the words when a burst of white chips exploded from the rock face and grit scraped past his ear.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成骂了一声，塔维还没听清，山壁上便炸开一小片白屑，碎石擦过他的耳朵。

pairs.target: nàgēn dài yǔ de duǎn shǐ dìng zài lí tā liǎn bùyuǎn de shífèng lǐ , wěiduān hái zài dǒu .
pairs.english: A short feathered bolt lodged in a crevice not far from his face, its tail still trembling.
pairs.hanzi: 那根带羽的短矢钉在离他脸不远的石缝里，尾端还在抖。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái kànjiàn tíng zhe de xiǎochē hòumiàn háiyǒu yígè rén , huáilǐ duānde búshì xiūlù gōngjù .
pairs.english: He only then saw there was another person behind the stopped cart; what he held in his arms was not a road tool.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才看见停着的小车后面还有一个人，怀里端的不是修路工具。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhuài zhe tā de lǐngzǐ wǎng qiángjiǎo yì yā , shēngyīn yíxià biàn le : " dūnxià . "
pairs.english: Nerai grabbed his collar and pressed him into the wall corner; her voice abruptly changed: “Down.”
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾拽着他的领子往墙角一压，声音一下变了：“蹲下。”
